title: Gastronomic Textures, Aromas, and Gustatory Memory

sections.title: Nuanced Adjectives for Food Textures and Flavors
sections.content: At the B2 level, describing food transcends simple evaluative terms like 'finom' or 'rossz'. Hungarian possesses a vivid descriptive vocabulary for textures and sensations: 'omlós' (tender, melting in the mouth, used for braised meats and crumbly pastries), 'selymes' (silky, smooth, used for emulsions and velvety soups), 'zamatos' (succulent, full-flavored, juicy), and 'fanyar' (astringent, pleasantly tart, typical of dry wines and certain wild berries).

sections.title: Describing the Temporal Progression of Tastes
sections.content: Gastronomic analysis pays close attention to the chronology of tasting: the initial impression (első benyomás / indítás), the core body (ízvilág / testesség), and the lingering finish (utóíz / lecsengés). A complex wine or mature cheese may start with fruity notes and end with a long, pleasantly bitter or mineral aftertaste ('hosszú, fanyar utóíz').

sections.title: Key Flavor and Texture Descriptors
rows: A lassan sült marhapofa rendkívül omlós maradt. (Tender / melting.)
A feketeribizli fanyar íze jól illik a vadhúsokhoz. (Tart / astringent.)
A nyári szegedi őszibarack bámulatosan zamatos. (Succulent / juicy.)
A csokoládénak hosszan tartó, nemes utóíze van. (Pleasant aftertaste.)

items.spanish: A mangalica tarja olyan omlósra sült, hogy alig kellett kést használni a felvágásához.
items.english: The mangalica pork collar was roasted so tender that one hardly needed a knife to slice it.

items.spanish: A tokaji furmint fanyar mineralitása tökéletesen kiegészíti a füstölt pisztráng gazdag zamatát.
items.english: The tart minerality of the Tokaj Furmint perfectly complements the rich flavor of the smoked trout.

items.spanish: A hagyományos magyar konyha ízvilága a paprika, a hagyma és a zsír ősi hármasára épül.
items.english: The flavor profile of traditional Hungarian cuisine is built on the ancient triad of paprika, onion, and lard.

items.spanish: A kávé kortyolása után kellemes pörkölt mogyorós utóíz maradt a szánkban.
items.english: After sipping the coffee, a pleasant roasted hazelnut aftertaste remained in our mouth.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Distinguish between 'savanyú' (plain sour, potentially unpleasant like spoiled milk) and 'fanyar' (astringent/tart, a sophisticated, desirable dry quality found in cranberries, quince, and tannins).
